claim: Every anomaly rule loops over nurseries that WROTE a health record, so a total outage raises the FEWEST rows. The worst state of the system sent the smallest email; panel coverage now leads the subject line.

body.replayed: 99 nights of data/scraper-health, 2026-06-11 to 2026-09-17. Fire rate was 37% (37 of 99), not the 4-in-5 the card reported: that was a burst.
body.the_finding_is_severity_not_rate: Every rule loops over nurseries that WROTE a health record, so a nursery that never ran is examined by nothing. On DEC-324's six total outages only 2 of 25 nurseries reported, so each raised ONE OR TWO anomalies against a routine night's one to three. Distribution over 99 nights: 62 clean, 13x1, 15x2, 7x3, then 21 and 23 (the two PARTIAL outages, where nurseries ran and failed loudly). The worst state of the system sent the smallest email.
body.panel_coverage_shipped: PANEL_COVERAGE_FLOOR = 0.75 against registered, non-dormant (DEC-330), seen-within-14-days nurseries. Leads the email AND the subject line, because counting rows cannot express severity when the failure mode suppresses rows.
body.threshold_is_measured: Coverage is bimodal: every healthy night >= 0.81, every outage night 0.07. Any threshold 0.60-0.80 scores identically (6 of 6 outages, zero others). 0.75 sits in the middle of the dead zone. PANEL_RECENT_DAYS=14 so a multi-night outage cannot redefine the panel down to its survivors (the DEC-330 shape).
body.zero_products_was_pure_duplication: Fired 36 times, all 36 on a nursery already reported failed the same night, never once independently. Suppressed when the run failed; kept for the ok-but-empty case it was written for.
body.count_swing_recoveries_suppressed: Fired 9 times, 8 were four V-shaped pairs (ladybird 7022-750-7035, garden-world 220-25-220, ladybird 7059-1250-7071, fruitopia 638-250-638). A swing returning the count to within the alarm's own band of the night before last is now suppressed. daleys 647->1998 (2026-08-20 source swap) is not a restoration and survives.
body.result: Rows 108 -> 74 (-31%); rows that were a second row about an already-failed nursery 44% -> 16%. Residue is blocked (why it failed) and failure_streak (it is day 3), both escalations that carry information, left alone.
body.two_rules_have_never_fired: source_change was written for the Daleys 2026-08-20 feed swap and COULD NOT SEE IT: source was None on both sides and only began being written 08-21. Armed now (27 of 27 records carry it) but never validated against a real event. priced_collapse shipped 08-24, 24 nights old. Recorded as unvalidated, not declared healthy or broken.
body.harness: tools/scrapers/backtest_scrape_anomalies.py, committed so the retune is re-derivable (DEC-313). Scores against the six labelled nights, exits 1 if any stops alarming.
body.guard: tests/test_scrape_anomaly_thresholds.py, 12 tests, 2 proven failing under the old rules. Full suite 3,756 tests, 1 known failure (DAL-306).
